paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekpen tengteng Israel suan inkuan a lupente, Jerusalem a kumpipa Solomon kiang ah David khopi, Zion a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in akaikhawm vek hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Tempul A Laklut Ahi / (2 Kro 5.2-6.2)

paite: Israel mi tengteng Ethanim kha, akha sagihna ah, ankuangluina ah kumpipa Solomon kiang ah akikaikhawm vek uhi.
Israel upa tengteng ahong ua, siampute'n bawm azawng uhi.
TOUPA bawm leh Kihoupihna Puanin leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng tan in siampute leh Levi chite'n azawngtou uhi.
Kumpipa Solomon leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm uh. Belam leh bawngtal atam ziak a sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
Siampute'n TOUPA thukhun bawm omna ding, insung a biakna mun a Mun Siangthoupen ah cherubte kha nuai ah alalut uhi.
Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ngal ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte ahuap vek uhi.
Azawnna chiangtawn asau mahmah ziak in, azawnna chiangtawn mongte biakna mun ma, mun siangthou a pan amuh theih hi. Himahleh inn polam ah zaw adawk kei, tuni tan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua TOUPA Israel suante toh thu akhun lai a Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoihte kia lou ngal, huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a pan ahong pawt khiaktak un meipi in TOUPA' inn ahong dim meuhmouh hi.
Meipi ziak in siampute nasem in a-om thei kei uh. TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn lah adimsak vek ngal a.
Solomon in thu agen a: "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding," achi hi.
"Na tenna ding in, tangtawn a na om gigena ding inn ka hon lamsak petmah hi,” achi hi.
Kumpipa akinunghei a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng avualzawl a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng adingh dipdep uhi.
heading: Mipite Kiang A Solomon Thugen / (2 Kro 6.3-11)

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, ka na David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,

Aigupta gam a pan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a pan Israel nam lak a koi lai khua leng ka min omna ding, inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei hi. Himahleh ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a ana genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
"Ka pa David in Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min dia inn lam alungsim in ana tum hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na lungsim in ka min a ding in inn lam na tum a, hichibang lungsim na put na hihhoih hi.
Himahleh nang zaw, inn na lam kei ding. Na tapa, na khal a hong pawtkhe ding in ka min a ding in inn alam zaw ding," ana chi hi.
"TOUPA'N athugen ahihkip a; TOUPA'N ana chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah in, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tuta a, Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min a ding in inn ka na lamta ngei hi.
Huai ah bawm omna ding mun ka na sep a, huai ah Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a i pute uh kiang a athukhun, TOUPA thukhun a-om,” achi hi.
TOUPA maitam ma, Israel hong kikhawm tengteng muh in Solomon adingh a, van lam ah akhut azaktou hi.
heading: Solomon Thumna / (2 Kro 6.2-42)

paite: "AW TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, na sikha lungtang tengteng na mitmuh a omte kiang a thukhun tangtun a hehpihna hihlang zel, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thuchiam tangtunpa, tunglam ah leh nuailam lei ah nang bang Pathian dang a-om kei.
Ahi, nang na kam in thu na gen a, na khut in na hon lohchingsakta a, tuni a, hong omta ngei bang in.

Huaiziak in aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a, na suante ka mitmuh a na om bang a ka mitmuh a om sam ding a a-omdan uh apilvan peuhmah uleh ka mitmuh in Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a na chiam tangtun in.
Aw Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thu na gensa hehpih in tungsak in."
"Himahleh lei ah Pathian ateng mahmah dia hia? Ngai in, van leh vante' van a leng ta lou na hi a; hiai ka inn lam ah nak tat tuak kei na tel chia!
Himahleh TOUPA ka Pathian, tuni a na sikha in ahon sapna thumna, athusam ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha in thum a thu asam ding ngaikhia a, nang, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun ngei a, inn lam a sun leh zan a na mit ahah gige theihna ding in.
Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in. Ahi, na tenna mun, van ah na ngaikhia in; ngaikhia inla, ngaidam in." \
"Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hial ahong kiphatmohleh hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla,
nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla na sikhate vai hawmsak in, migilou pen mohpaih in alutung ah a-omdan nga inla, midiktat pen siamtangsak in adiktatna bangbang amah pia in.
Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min aphat ua, hiai inn a thum a thil ahon nget uleh,
nang van ah ana ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apute uh gam na piak ah pikik nawn in."
"Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van akikhak a, vuah ahong zuk louh hun chiang in, hiai mun lam nga a ahong thum ua, na min apuankhiak ua, amau na bawl gentheih ziak a akhelhnate uh akisik uleh,
nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih sinsak inla, na mite goutan dia na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in."
"Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akongpi kim ua ahong um ua, hipi khatpeuh, chinatna bangpeuh ahong tunleh,
na mi Israel tengteng lak a amau lungtang a hipi om hi a thei a, hiai inn lam nga a khut zankhia a, thumna leh ngetna ahon lat uleh;
na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, gamtang inla, nang alungtang uh theipa, michih a-omdan bangbang in lohchingsak in; nang, nang kia lah mihing ta tengteng lungtang theipa na hi ngal a.
Ka pute uh na piak gam a aten lai teng uh nang ahon lauhtheihna ding un."
"Na mi Israelte hilou namdang, na min ziak a gam gamlapi a pan hong paite tungtang thu leng;
na min thupi mahmah, na khut hat mahmah, na ban na zak thu na za chiat ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n hiai inn lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un,

nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, namdang in hon nget ana hihsak in. Na mi Israelte bangmah a leitung mite'n na min atheih ua, laudan ahong siam ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min pu ahi chih ahon theihtheihna ding un."
"Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam ah adou ua, na khopi tel lam nga leh na min a dia ka lam inn lam nga a, TOUPA kiang a ahong thum uleh,
athumna uleh angetna uh nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in."
"Na tung a thil ahihkhelh uleh, kuamah thil hihkhial lou lah a-om ngal kei a; atung ua na hehna, melma gam gamla mahmah hiam, naichik hiam a leng sal a api ua;
sal a apina gam ua ahong kingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, thil i na hihkhialta, dikloutak leh gilou mahmah in i na gamta uh, chi a sal a pi mite gam a nang ahon nget uleh,
amelma amau sal a pite gam a alungtangtak uleh alungsimtak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, apute uh na piak gam lam leh na khopi tel lam leh na min a dia ka inn lamlam nga a na kiang a ahong thum uleh;
athumna uleh angetna uh nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in.
Na mi na tung a thil hihkhialte leh na tung a ana tatlekna uah atatleknate tengteng uh ngaidam inla; sal a pite'n ahehpih theihna ding un hehpihna neisak in.
Na mi na goutan, Aigupta gam a pan sik haltuina sung a pan na pikhiakte lah ahi ngal ua."
"Ahon sap chiang ua na ngaihkhiak dia, na sikha ngetna leh na mi Israelte ngetna lam a na mit na hah gige theihna ding in.
Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ka pute uh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak lai a na sikha Mosi zang a na gen bang in na goutan ding in leitung mite lak a pan na hihtuam lah ahi ngal ua,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA kiang a athumna leh ngetna tengteng agen khit in, TOUPA maitam ma a khukdin a, van lam a akhut zaktou a om lai athou hi.
heading: Thumna Nanung

paite: Adingtou a, aw ngaihtak in Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl hi.
"Athuchiam tengteng bang zel a, ami Israelte khawlna pepa TOUPA phat in om hen. Asikha Mosi zang a athuchiam hoih tengteng thu khat leng avuaksuak kei," chi in.
"TOUPA i Pathian, i pute kiang a a-om bang in i kiang uah om henla; hon paisan in hon donsak lou kei hen.
Huchi in alampi tengteng tawn ding leh i pipute ana piak khitsa bang a, athupiakte, adan thusehte, avaihawmte zui dia i lungtangte ama lam a angatsak theihna ding in.
Asikha thu leh ami Israelte thu ah ani omdan bang zel a, agamtat theihna ding in hiai ka thugen, TOUPA ma a ngetna ka tutte sun leh zan in TOUPA i Pathian ma ah om gige hen.
TOUPA Pathian ahi a, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih leitung a mite'n atheihtheihna ding in.
Huchi in adan thuseh bang a om ding leh athupiakte zui ding in TOUPA i Pathian lam ah na lungtangte uh hoihkim hen, tuni a bang in.”
Israel tengteng leh Solomon in TOUPA ma ah kithoihna alan uhi.
heading: Tempul Latna / (2 Kro 7.4-10)

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia alat kilemna kithoihna ding in bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih ahi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh Israel suan tengteng in TOUPA' inn alan uhi.

Huai ni mah in kumpipa'n TOUPA inka zawn a intual huangsung laitak ahihsiangthou hi. Huai ah halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat thaute alan hi. Aziak bel huai halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat sathaute huai dal maitam atat zoh louh ziak ahi.

Huchi in huai hun in Solomon leh Israel tengteng, mipi kikhawm tampi, Hamath lutna a pan Aigupta gam lui pha a mite'n TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ni sagih leh ni sagih, ni sawm-le-li sung ankuang aluikhawm uhi.

Ani giat ni in mipite akikhensak a, amau kumpipa avualzawl ua, huchi in TOUPA'N asikha David leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna huchi lawmlawm a alatsak ziak in lungsim nuamsa leh kipak mahmah in a-inn lam uah apaita uhi.
